title: DynaWax
description:
DynaWax is made from beeswax with some added hemp oil for consistency.
It has many uses including but not limited to lubricating o-rings, polishing wood dynastashes, midsections and mouthpieces, lubricating facial hair and much more. 😉
Included
1 x DynaWax
